title: 2 weeks ago I said fuzz it and went for it
author: frankenstein-0x00e
selftext:
pretty much this, I have more cars in the work

I realized instead of caving in and fighting ghosts of anti ai people I decided that this is what I want to make

  
building modular Systems (sound, physics, grab and drop etc) , a playground and whole lot of stuff

  
not much but this is where I test things, the actual game will come out from these 

  
Trying to find a good game feel releasing a demo maybe soon for feedback 

  
(sorry I could not remove the ending which could count as self promo but not commercial yet because this is not the game but like , augh



but I am not impersonating this is just not my main account)



Still yet to experiment with different aesthetics focusing on physics for now and sound for the car :3

comments.author: frankenstein-0x00e
comments.body:
I am not used to posting or sharing yet that's why its messy

tools: 

Claude obviously, Godot with claude (my own custom tools, not mcp) blender official mcp + custom tools)

Engine sound is based on open-source simulator by AngeTheGreat (Ange Yaghi, MIT licence) but changed it to fit my style 

and yeah pretty much all 3D models done by Claude (and me :3 in the loop) no Mesh Gen or Image Gen

replies.author: frankenstein-0x00e
replies.body:
Thanks!

it takes time to get the models right, you need to have a car in mind and references from real cars and mix them together 

I even use paint to draw on car images how I want  certain shapes and that's it keep iterating with Claude in blender and ask it to always verify what it changes with screenshots 



dont forget to make your own tools for complex shapes or edges!

replies.author: WhichAd3240
replies.body: thank you, that's exactly what I do too :) it seems to me that llms really are stochastic parrots, because I tried to build the pipeline for 5-6 times already and only on 7th time starting again from scratch it seems it finally worked :)
